Population.evidence_source: Many participants talked about the deceased by describing their shock in the aftermath of a suicide they perceived to be unforeseen. Although these suicides were seemingly without warning, some participants reflected, in hindsight, on potential telltale signs that might have indicated that the deceased was at risk.

Area.evidence_source: Risk: In this context, a selective stoicism or quietness was linked to the deceased with participants pointing to disparities about what the men must really have been feeling and/or experiencing in their life, and leading up to their death. Recovery: I think if all you tell your kids is the good stuff, the great stuff, then that's what they see; they see the good things. Every time they see you as an adult . . . you've kind of got your stuff together. So I think [participant's son], he would see us somewhat struggle, but you don't tell them all of it, maybe you don't remember what it felt like when you were 15.
